item.coloph: rgyud dang man ngag thams cad kyi don phyogs gcig tu bsdebs mtshan ma gyen 'greng thig le'i 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag rdo rje tshig rnam par dbye ba zhes bya ba rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paN+Di ta a mo g+ha badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so
